data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableBackgroundApps.ShortDescription
data.value: Prevents inactive applications from running in the background to free up RAM and reduce CPU overhead.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.ProcessPriority.ShortDescription
data.value: Allocates more CPU resources to the application you are currently using for a faster, more responsive experience.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.OptimizeMultimediaScheduler.ShortDescription
data.value: Configures the Multimedia Class Scheduler Service (MMCSS) for gaming and low latency by prioritizing multimedia workloads and disabling network throttling.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.LiftWebDavFileSizeLimit.ShortDescription
data.value: Raises the WebClient file size limit for WebDAV mounts from 50 MB to 4 GB so large files stop failing on network locations.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.KeyboardLatencyOptimization.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets the fastest keyboard repeat delay and repeat rate for more responsive typing and repeated key presses.

data.name: Optimizer.Performance.DisableAccessibilityKeyboardHotkeys.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables Sticky Keys, Filter Keys, and Toggle Keys keyboard shortcuts to prevent accidental pop-ups during gaming and typing.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableHibernateAndFastStartup.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off hibernation and Fast Startup to reclaim disk space and ensure a full shutdown for cleaner hardware initialization on boot.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisableUSBPowerSaving.ShortDescription
data.value: Prevents Windows from powering down USB ports, eliminating wake-up delays for mice, keyboards, and other peripherals.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.InstallOptimizerDuckPowerPlan.ShortDescription
data.value: Installs a custom performance-focused power plan to ensure your system always runs at maximum speed. Warning: May cause Task Manager to incorrectly show 100% CPU usage on some systems, actual CPU load is unaffected.

data.name: Optimizer.PowerManagement.DisablePowerSaving.ShortDescription
data.value: Prevents Windows from limiting CPU performance (Power Throttling) to maintain peak power for active tasks.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableTelemetry.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables Windows telemetry and usage tracking services to enhance your personal privacy and reduce background activity.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableErrorReporting.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables Windows Error Reporting and Program Compatibility Assistant services.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableAdvertisingAndSuggestions.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables personalized ads, Windows consumer features, and system suggestions.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableNewsAndInterests.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off the News and Interests feed and hides its taskbar button (Windows 10), and disables the Widgets board (Windows 11).

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.HideMeetNowButton.ShortDescription
data.value: Hides the Meet Now (Skype) button from the taskbar notification area. Windows 10 only.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableActivityHistory.ShortDescription
data.value: Prevents Windows from collecting and syncing your activity history.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableLocationAndSensors.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables location tracking, system sensors, and offline maps updates.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableAutoLogger.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops non-essential WMI/ETW AutoLogger sessions (Diagtrack-Listener, SQMLogger, etc.) from starting at boot to reduce background disk and CPU activity. Note: security software may flag AutoLogger changes as they alter diagnostic tracing.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableCortana.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off the Cortana voice assistant and disables cloud search and web results in Windows Search (Windows 10 only).

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableCopilot.ShortDescription
data.value: Removes the AI Copilot assistant from the taskbar and system shell to free up memory and screen space.

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableContentDeliveryManager.ShortDescription
data.value: Turns off Windows cloud-delivered content, including system tips, spotlight suggestions, and automatic delivery of consumer features.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.DisablePreinstalledApps.ShortDescription
data.value: Prevents Windows from automatically re-installing unwanted third-party apps and promoted software.

data.name: Optimizer.BloatwareAndServices.ConfigureServices.ShortDescription
data.value: Adjusts non-essential background services to free up resources while maintaining all necessary Windows functionality.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.SpeedUpExplorerAndMenus.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets StartupDelayInMSec=0, MenuShowDelay=0 to eliminate Explorer startup delay and reduce menu hover delay to minimum.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.MaximizeUpdatePauseLimit.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets the Windows Update pause ceiling to the largest supported value. Only honored by Windows versions that still support this setting; security updates stay paused while it is active.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.DisableStartMenuWebSearch.ShortDescription
data.value: Turn off web search for Windows Start Menu to load the local search results faster.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.DisableVisualEffects.ShortDescription
data.value: Disables taskbar animations, listview shadows, window transparency, and Aero Peek to free up GPU/CPU resources for better performance.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableUlps.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets EnableULPS=0 in AMD GPU registry to prevent Ultra Low Power State wake-up delays and multi-monitor issues. Reduces power saving on idle.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisablePowerGating.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets DisablePowerGating=1, PP_GPUPowerDownEnabled=0, DisableDynamicPstate=1 to prevent AMD GPU power state transitions. Maintains consistent clocks at cost of higher idle power.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableVideoClockGating.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets DisableVCEPowerGating=1, DisableVceClockGating=1, EnableUvdClockGating=0 for AMD video engines (VCE/UVD) to improve encode/decode stability. Increases video playback power.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.AmdDisableAspm.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets EnableAspmL0s=0, EnableAspmL1=0 to disable Active State Power Management on AMD GPUs, reducing PCIe bus latency. Increases slot power consumption.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.NvidiaDisableDynamicPstate.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets DisableDynamicPstate=1 to lock NVIDIA GPU into fixed performance state, preventing clock speed fluctuations. Increases idle power draw.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.NvidiaDisableAsyncPstates.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets DisableASyncPstates=1 to prevent NVIDIA asynchronous power state switching, providing deterministic performance for VR/real-time apps.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.IntelDisableAsyncFlips.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets Display1_DisableAsyncFlips=1 to force synchronous buffer flips on Intel iGPU, reducing input-to-display latency and screen tearing.

data.name: Optimizer.Gpu.IntelDisableAdaptiveVsync.ShortDescription
data.value: Sets AdaptiveVsyncEnable=0 to disable Intel's adaptive V-Sync that dynamically adjusts to frame rate, using fixed V-Sync instead for stable timing.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarWidgets.Description
data.value: Shows or hides the Widgets button on the taskbar. Widgets provide quick access to news, weather, and other updates.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarWidgets.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Widgets feature can fetch news and weather in the background, which may increase idle network and memory usage.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarAlignment.Description
data.value: Choose whether taskbar icons sit in the center or align to the left.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.CombineTaskbarButtons.Description
data.value: Choose when to combine taskbar buttons and hide labels across all displays.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ExplorerCompactMode.Description
data.value: Tightens the spacing between items in File Explorer for a more compact view.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.SnapAssistFlyout.Description
data.value: Shows or hides the Snap Layouts menu when you hover over a window's maximize button.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ExplorerItemCheckboxes.Description
data.value: Shows check boxes next to items in File Explorer, making it easier to select several files at once.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarTaskViewButton.Description
data.value: Shows or hides the Task View button on the taskbar.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarEndTask.Description
data.value: Adds an End task command to the taskbar context menu, so you can close an unresponsive app without opening Task Manager.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.TaskbarEndTask.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: End Task on the taskbar lets you kill frozen apps instantly without opening Task Manager.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.DarkMode.Description
data.value: Applies dark colors to Windows apps, Settings, and other shell elements.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ExplorerSyncNotifications.Description
data.value: Shows or hides notifications from OneDrive and other cloud sync providers in File Explorer.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ExplorerSyncNotifications.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Explorer Sync Notifications feature controls OneDrive and cloud-sync pop-ups while browsing files.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.SystemSuggestions.Description
data.value: Shows or hides Windows tips and app suggestions in Settings.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.SystemSuggestions.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The System Suggestions feature controls Windows recommendations for apps and settings.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ToastNotifications.Description
data.value: Controls toast notifications, including alerts that appear on the desktop or lock screen.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowFileExtensions.Description
data.value: Shows or hides file extensions such as .txt and .exe in File Explorer.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowFileExtensions.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: File extensions make suspicious file types easier to spot and prevent malware from hiding behind misleading icons.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowHiddenFiles.Description
data.value: Shows or hides hidden files and folders in File Explorer.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowHiddenFiles.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Hidden files contain system and configuration data that may be needed for administration and troubleshooting.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ClipboardHistory.Description
data.value: Keeps a history of copied items that you can browse with Win+V.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ClipboardHistory.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Clipboard history lets you recall multiple past copies with Win+V, speeding up repetitive copy-paste workflows.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.WindowShake.Description
data.value: Shake the active window to minimize the others, or turn this behavior off.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ClassicContextMenu.Description
data.value: Uses the classic Windows 10-style context menu instead of the condensed Windows 11 menu.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ClassicContextMenu.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The classic menu shows all options at once without the extra click needed to expand Windows 11's condensed menu.

data.name: Customize.Preferences.ShowSecondsInSystemClock.Description
data.value: Shows seconds in the taskbar clock.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.GameMode.Description
data.value: Gives games priority for system resources and changes how Windows Update behaves while you play.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.GameMode.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Game Mode automatically prioritizes game processes and suspends Windows Update notifications while gaming for smoother performance.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.GameBar.Description
data.value: Shows the Xbox Game Bar and its related overlays and background features.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.GameBar.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Xbox Game Bar feature provides overlays and background gaming tools that may use system resources.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.BackgroundRecording.Description
data.value: Records gameplay and app activity in the background through Game DVR.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.BackgroundRecording.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Background Recording feature captures gameplay in the background, which can use CPU resources and create disk writes.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.MouseAcceleration.Description
data.value: Adjusts how cursor movement responds to the speed of your mouse.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.MouseAcceleration.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: The Mouse Acceleration feature changes cursor movement based on speed; raw linear input can improve aim consistency.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.FullscreenOptimizations.Description
data.value: Applies Windows' fullscreen optimizations, which can improve compatibility for some games.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.FullscreenOptimizations.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: Disable it if you experience in-game stuttering, input lag, or black screens (especially in competitive shooters).

data.name: Customize.Gaming.HardwareAcceleratedGpuScheduling.Description
data.value: Lets the GPU handle more video-memory scheduling work. A compatible graphics driver is required.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.HardwareAcceleratedGpuScheduling.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: GPU scheduling offloads frame management from the CPU to the GPU, cutting display latency and improving frame pacing.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.DlssIndicator.Description
data.value: Controls the on-screen DLSS indicator overlay used to verify which DLSS version a game actually renders with.

data.name: Customize.Gaming.DlssIndicator.Recommendation.Reason
data.value: A diagnostic overlay; leave off unless you are checking DLSS behavior.

data.name: Customize.SystemFeatures.VerboseStatus.Description

data.name: Customize.SystemFeatures.UtcHardwareClock.Description

data.name: Customize.SystemFeatures.UtcHardwareClock.Recommendation.Reason

data.name: Customize.SystemFeatures.DisableSmartNameResolution.Description
